title: ReadOnBranchResponse
description: The commit the files were read at, and each file's text, or no text when the commit holds no such file. The kernel records this answer, so a script that called for it reads the same texts when its calls are replayed.

commit.description: The commit the worktree was cut at, in full.

files.description: One entry for each path asked for, in its order.

text.description: The file's text; left out when the commit holds no such file.

stayed.description: A branch forge asked to drop and worktrees kept, with the reason it gave; left out when every drop went through.

reason.description: worktrees.drop-branch's sentence: why the branch was kept and what would let it go.
